pass_rule.score_formula: 100 * sum(weight * passed) / sum(weight * applicable), over every applicable (row, scored rule) pair; a submission with no applicable scored checks scores 100
pass_rule.rounding: one decimal place; 79.95 rounds to 80.0 and passes

commit_policy: all_or_nothing per submission; rejected submissions save nothing to live tables but are kept in staging for fix-and-retry

rules.check: Extension is .xlsx or .csv. Reject .xlsm, .xls and anything with macros.
rules.message_en: This file type is not accepted. Save it as .xlsx from the official template and upload again.
rules.message_fr: Ce type de fichier n'est pas accepté. Enregistrez-le au format .xlsx à partir du modèle officiel et réessayez.

rules.check: File size is 5 MB or less.
rules.message_en: The file is larger than 5 MB. Split it into smaller files or remove unused sheets.
rules.message_fr: Le fichier dépasse 5 Mo. Divisez-le ou supprimez les feuilles inutilisées.

rules.check: Template version cell equals a supported version (current and the one before).
rules.message_en: This template version is out of date. Download the current template and copy your rows into it.
rules.message_fr: Cette version du modèle est obsolète. Téléchargez le modèle actuel et copiez-y vos lignes.

rules.check: At least one data sheet with a known name is present (Workstreams, Deliverables, Activities, Milestones, Stage_Updates, Risks, Decisions, Actions, Indicator_Values, Evidence_Register).
rules.message_en: No recognised data sheet was found. Do not rename the template sheets.
rules.message_fr: Aucune feuille de données reconnue. Ne renommez pas les feuilles du modèle.

rules.check: Header row of every data sheet matches the template exactly (names and order).
rules.message_en: The column headings on sheet {sheet} were changed. Restore them from the template.
rules.message_fr: Les en-têtes de colonnes de la feuille {sheet} ont été modifiés. Rétablissez-les à partir du modèle.

rules.check: No formulas in data cells. Values only.
rules.message_en: Sheet {sheet} contains formulas (for example cell {cell}). Paste values only.
rules.message_fr: La feuille {sheet} contient des formules (par exemple la cellule {cell}). Collez uniquement des valeurs.

rules.check: At least one data row in total; no more than 2,000 rows per sheet.
rules.message_en: The file has no data rows, or a sheet has more than 2,000 rows.
rules.message_fr: Le fichier ne contient aucune ligne de données, ou une feuille dépasse 2 000 lignes.

rules.check: SHA-256 of the file does not match an upload already accepted in the last 90 days.
rules.message_en: This exact file was already accepted on {date}. Nothing new to load.
rules.message_fr: Ce fichier a déjà été accepté le {date}. Rien de nouveau à charger.

rules.check: ID present and matches the pattern for the entity (see id_patterns). Blank ID is allowed only on a new row in the web form, where the system assigns it.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: the ID "{value}" is missing or in the wrong format. Expected something like {example}.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : l'identifiant « {value} » est manquant ou au mauvais format. Format attendu : {example}.

rules.check: ID is unique within the submission.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: ID {value} appears more than once in this file.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : l'identifiant {value} apparaît plusieurs fois dans ce fichier.

rules.check: Every parent or reference ID exists (reform_id, workstream_id, deliverable_id, milestone_id, indicator_code, linked object IDs).
rules.message_en: Row {row}: {field} "{value}" does not exist. Check the spelling or create it first.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : {field} « {value} » n'existe pas. Vérifiez l'orthographe ou créez-le d'abord.

rules.check: Every controlled field holds a value from its active list (status, RAG, stage, type, category, confidence, priority, treatment, decision type, trigger type, frequency, unit).
rules.message_en: Row {row}: "{value}" is not an accepted value for {field}. Choose one of: {allowed}.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : « {value} » n'est pas une valeur acceptée pour {field}. Choisissez parmi : {allowed}.

rules.check: Date fields are real dates (ISO or Excel date cells, not text and not bare numbers) between 2026-01-01 and 2031-12-31.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: {field} "{value}" is not a valid date between 2026 and 2031.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : {field} « {value} » n'est pas une date valide entre 2026 et 2031.

rules.check: Start or entry date is on or before due or exit date.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: the start date is after the due date.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : la date de début est postérieure à la date d'échéance.

rules.check: Actual or exit date is not in the future.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: the actual date {value} is in the future.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : la date réelle {value} est dans le futur.

rules.check: An owner is set on every active item (status not in (complete, cancelled)). Owner must be a registered person, not free text.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: no owner. Every open item needs a named person responsible.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : aucun responsable. Chaque élément en cours doit avoir une personne nommée.

rules.check: Status complete requires at least one linked evidence item (existing EV- ID or an uploaded file) and an actual or exit date.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: marked complete with no evidence or completion date. Attach the evidence (minute, letter, report) and the date.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : marqué terminé sans preuve ni date d'achèvement. Joignez la preuve (procès-verbal, lettre, rapport) et la date.

rules.check: Numeric fields are numbers in range: progress_pct 0 to 100; likelihood and impact 1 to 5; readiness score 0 to 100; indicator value not negative unless the indicator allows it.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: {field} "{value}" must be a number between {min} and {max}.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : {field} « {value} » doit être un nombre entre {min} et {max}.

rules.check: Uploader may write to the row's reform (user_reform_scope). For on-behalf entry, the subject person must also be in scope.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: you do not have permission to update {value}. Ask the administrator.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : vous n'avez pas l'autorisation de modifier {value}. Contactez l'administrateur.

rules.check: The reporting period is open. Values for a closed (locked) period cannot be changed by upload or form; use a change request.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: the period ending {value} is closed. Submit a change request instead.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : la période se terminant le {value} est clôturée. Soumettez une demande de modification.

rules.check: Actual date is empty when status is not_started.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: an item that has not started cannot have an actual completion date.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : un élément non démarré ne peut pas avoir de date d'achèvement réelle.

rules.check: Text cells contain no line of HTML or script and are 2,000 characters or fewer.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: {field} is too long or contains code.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : {field} est trop long ou contient du code.

rules.check: Evidence file: type is pdf, jpg, jpeg, png, docx or xlsx; size 10 MB or less after compression; not a duplicate (SHA-256) of an existing file.
rules.message_en: The evidence file is the wrong type, too large, or already uploaded as {existing}.
rules.message_fr: Le fichier de preuve est du mauvais type, trop volumineux ou déjà téléversé sous {existing}.

rules.check: Evidence is linked to at least one object (reform, workstream, deliverable, activity, milestone, stage, decision, risk or indicator value).
rules.message_en: This evidence is not linked to anything. Say which milestone, decision or indicator it supports.
rules.message_fr: Cette preuve n'est liée à rien. Indiquez le jalon, la décision ou l'indicateur qu'elle appuie.

rules.check: Trim leading and trailing spaces in IDs and codes.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: removed extra spaces in {field}.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : espaces supprimés dans {field}.

rules.check: Case-insensitive match to a list value is normalised to the canonical value (for example "In Progress" to in_progress).
rules.message_en: Row {row}: "{value}" read as "{canonical}".
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : « {value} » interprété comme « {canonical} ».

rules.check: Next action filled on active items.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: add the next action so the team knows what happens next.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : indiquez la prochaine action.

rules.check: Blocker or comment filled when status is at_risk, delayed or blocked.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: explain what is blocking or delaying this item.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : expliquez ce qui bloque ou retarde cet élément.

rules.check: Forecast date given when status is delayed, or when due date has passed and status is not complete.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: give a new expected date.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : indiquez une nouvelle date prévue.

rules.check: Status is not on_track when due date has passed and item is not complete.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: the due date has passed but the status says on track. Update the status.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : l'échéance est dépassée mais le statut indique « dans les temps ». Mettez à jour le statut.

rules.check: Progress agrees with status: complete is 100, not_started is 0, otherwise 1 to 99.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: progress {value}% does not match status {status}.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : la progression {value} % ne correspond pas au statut {status}.

rules.check: If a manual RAG differs from the computed RAG, a reason is given.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: you set RAG to {value}. Add the reason for overriding the calculated rating.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : vous avez fixé le RAG à {value}. Ajoutez la raison de cette modification.

rules.check: Evidence confidence (high, medium, low) given.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: rate how confident you are in the evidence.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : évaluez votre niveau de confiance dans la preuve.

rules.check: Names and descriptions are at least 10 characters and are not placeholders (TBC, TBD, N/A, x, test, "POC placeholder", copied header names).
rules.message_en: Row {row}: {field} looks like a placeholder. Write what it actually is.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : {field} ressemble à un texte provisoire. Décrivez-le réellement.

rules.check: Dependencies, when given, point to existing items and do not create a loop.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: dependency {value} not found or creates a loop.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : dépendance {value} introuvable ou circulaire.

rules.check: Open risks have mitigation, trigger and review date.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: an open risk needs a mitigation, a trigger and a review date.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : un risque ouvert nécessite une mesure, un déclencheur et une date de revue.

rules.check: Residual score is not higher than inherent score.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: residual risk is higher than inherent risk. Check the scores.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : le risque résiduel dépasse le risque inhérent.

rules.check: Review date for an open risk is not in the past.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: this risk was due for review on {value}. Review it and set the next date.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : ce risque devait être revu le {value}.

rules.check: Open decisions have a follow-up action, owner and due date.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: a decision needs a follow-up action, an owner and a due date.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : une décision nécessite une action de suivi, un responsable et une échéance.

rules.check: Evidence basis given for every value.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: say where this number comes from.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : indiquez l'origine de ce chiffre.

rules.check: Confidence level given.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: rate your confidence in this value.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : évaluez votre confiance dans cette valeur.

rules.check: Proxy values carry a comment explaining the proxy.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: explain what the proxy measures.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : expliquez ce que mesure la valeur approximative.

rules.check: A change of more than 50% from the previous approved value carries a comment.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: the value moved from {prev} to {value}. Explain the change.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : la valeur est passée de {prev} à {value}. Expliquez ce changement.

rules.check: Each target states whether it is Year 1 or life of programme.
rules.message_en: Indicator {value}: say whether the target is Year 1 or life of programme.
rules.message_fr: Indicateur {value} : précisez si la cible est annuelle (année 1) ou pour toute la durée du programme.

rules.check: Evidence has source institution, date and type.
rules.message_en: Add the source institution, date and type of this evidence.
rules.message_fr: Ajoutez l'institution source, la date et le type de cette preuve.

rules.check: Escalation target given when escalation_needed is true.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: escalation is needed. Say to whom.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : une escalade est nécessaire. Indiquez à qui.

rules.check: All six readiness dimensions rated and assessor named.
rules.message_en: Rate all six readiness dimensions and name the assessor.
rules.message_fr: Évaluez les six dimensions de préparation et nommez l’évaluateur.

rules.check: Approved adaptations carry rationale, approver and date.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: an approved change needs the reason, who approved it and when.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : une modification approuvée doit indiquer la raison, l'approbateur et la date.

rules.check: Item updated within the last 30 days (staleness). Checked on the stored record at each submission and nightly.
rules.message_en: Row {row}: not updated since {value}. Confirm it is still accurate.
rules.message_fr: Ligne {row} : non mis à jour depuis le {value}. Confirmez qu’il est toujours exact.

rules.check: Indicators whose name starts with "Percentage" use unit %.
rules.message_en: Indicator {value}: a percentage indicator must use the unit %.
rules.message_fr: Indicateur {value} : un indicateur en pourcentage doit utiliser l’unité %.
